10k.note: Medical-device (AI-ECG) company. MyoVista wav ECG and MyoVista Insights Cloud Platform; no drug assets. Pre-FDA-clearance Class II device (510(k) / De Novo pathway).

website.note: Corporate site documents the MyoVista wav ECG device and AI-ECG algorithm portfolio (impaired cardiac relaxation, low ejection fraction, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, aortic stenosis); no investigational drug pipeline page.

ctgov.note: No HeartSciences-sponsored P1/P2/P3 drug trials. Past device validation work disclosed only in 10-K, not as drug-trial registrations.

commercial_product.lead_product: MyoVista wav ECG (resting 12-lead ECG with embedded AI-ECG impaired cardiac relaxation algorithm)
commercial_product.platform: MyoVista Insights Cloud Platform (hardware-agnostic AI-ECG algorithm hosting; planned 510(k) submission for low-ejection-fraction algorithm in 1H CY2026)
additional_algorithms: Aortic stenosis ECG algorithm — FDA Breakthrough Device designation granted June 2025
Low ejection fraction algorithm (licensed from Mount Sinai, Sept 2023)
Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and additional Mount Sinai-licensed algorithms (early-stage)
commercial_product.regulatory_status: Class II device; no FDA marketing clearance yet. FDA validation study patient recruitment and core-lab work complete; 510(k) submission previously planned for CY2025, now being re-aligned to July-2025 ASE LVDD guidelines before submission.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Adjacent medtech / AI-ECG diagnostic device company with no proprietary drug pipeline. Lead asset is the Class II MyoVista wav ECG device pursuing FDA 510(k) clearance, plus a portfolio of AI-ECG algorithms (impaired cardiac relaxation, low EF, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, aortic stenosis); no sponsor-led P1/P2/P3 drug trials in ClinicalTrials.gov.
